name: Open Food Facts API
summary: Crowd-sourced database of 3M+ food products with ingredients, nutrition, Nutri-Score, NOVA and allergens.
description: Look up packaged food by barcode or search by category, brand, additive, label or nutrient. Returns ingredients text, nutriments per 100g, Nutri-Score, Eco-Score, NOVA group, allergens and images. An open data dump (JSONL, CSV, Parquet) is also published.

auth.notes: Reads are anonymous; writes need an account.

required_headers.name: User-Agent
required_headers.notes: Required, in the form AppName/Version (contact email).

rate_limit.summary: Documented: 100 requests/minute for product reads, 10 requests/minute for search, 2 requests/minute for facet queries.

license.name: Database ODbL 1.0; contents DbCL; images CC BY-SA

coverage.geographic: Global, 3M+ products (strongest in France and Europe)

agent_notes: Always pass fields= to keep payloads small. The barcode (EAN/UPC) is the primary key. Send a User-Agent of the form AppName/Version (contact) and respect the stricter search limits; use the dumps for bulk analysis.
caveats: Crowd-sourced, so data quality varies per product.
ODbL share-alike applies to derived databases.
